# Aurora Robotics Employee Handbook (Version 1, effective January 2022)

## Work Schedule

The standard work week at Aurora Robotics is 40 hours. All employees are expected to be available during core hours of 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM local time so that teams can collaborate effectively. Outside of core hours, employees may arrange their schedule with their manager.

## Remote Work Policy

Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with prior manager approval. Requests for additional remote days must be submitted in writing and approved on a case-by-case basis by the employee's manager and HR.

## Paid Time Off

Full-time employees accrue 15 days of paid time off (PTO) per year, accrued monthly at a rate of 1.25 days per month. Unused PTO may be carried over up to a maximum of 5 days into the following calendar year.

## Parental Leave

Aurora Robotics offers 8 weeks of paid parental leave for the birth, adoption, or fostering of a child. Parental leave may be taken within the first 12 months following the qualifying event.

## Health Benefits

Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage begins on an employee's first day of employment. Aurora Robotics covers 80% of the premium cost for employees and 50% for dependents.

## Expense Reports

Employees must submit expense reports for reimbursement within 30 days of incurring the expense. Reports submitted after 30 days may be denied at management's discretion.

## Dress Code

Aurora Robotics maintains a business casual dress code in all office locations. Client-facing roles and field service technicians should follow additional guidance provided by their department.
